title: "Data for SE2I2R model with covariate in Central America"

################################################################################
Purpose of script: Check climate and school data and create covars df for the 
SE2I2R model (Central America)
Output:
- df_covars (covariate for the SE2I2R model)
################################################################################

# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
source("04_00_pck.R")
dirs$out_sav <- glue("{dirs$outputs}/camerica_climcovars")
```

# Read in and plot school and climate data 
```{r}
# School terms
dat_school <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/data_school_calendar.rds")) %>%
  filter(country != "colombia") %>%
  filter(country != "mexico")
dat_school[dat_school == 0] <- -1
# Climatic variables 
dat_clim <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/data_clim_sel_week_narr_cam.rds")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("w_"), names_to = "clim_var") %>% 
  filter(clim_var == "w_hum_spe") %>%
  mutate(week = str_remove(week, pattern = "week_"),
         week = as.integer(week))

# Plot data school calendar
ggplot(dat_school, 
       aes(x = as.numeric(week), y = school, color = country)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~country) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
# Plot data climate
pl_clim_l <- list()
for (i in unique(dat_clim$country)) {
pl_clim_l[i] <- list(
  ggplot(dat_clim %>%
          filter(country == i), 
         aes(x = week, y = value, color = reorder(mun_name, mun_latitude), 
             group = mun_name)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(.~reorder(mun_name, -mun_latitude), scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d() + 
  ggtitle(i) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none"))
}
pl_clim_l
```

# Data as covars 
```{r}
df_covars <- dat_clim %>%
  group_by(clim_var, country, mun_name, mun_city_name, 
           mun_latitude, mun_longitude, week) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(clim_var, country, mun_name) %>%
  mutate(value_stand = scale(value)) %>%
  ungroup()

pl_covars_l <- list()
for (i in unique(dat_clim$country)) {
pl_covars_l[i] <- list(
  ggplot(df_covars %>%
           filter(country == i), 
         aes(x = week, y = value_stand, color = reorder(mun_name, mun_latitude), 
             group = mun_name)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~ reorder(mun_name, -mun_latitude), scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d() + 
  ggtitle(i) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none"))
}
pl_covars_l
```

```{r}
saveRDS(df_covars, file = glue("{dirs$out_sav}/df_covars.rds"))
```
